item.text: The profile currently has no explicit default font-size preference, so Chrome is using its medium default. I’m going to close Chrome cleanly, set the standard and fixed-width default font sizes to `24`, which is Chrome’s “Very large” setting, then reopen it.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'pkill -TERM -x chrome || true
for i in $(seq 1 20); do pgrep -x chrome >/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done
pgrep -a chrome || true'
